budget_note: This is the winner-scale successor to the running scoreable protenix5 attack. It keeps the fixed 175-target benchmark scoring set, predicts only the 74 jobs that currently have a locally available reference alias, restores phase-alias A1B4 stoichiometry for H0220/H1220/H2220, and schedules exact oligo jobs by token count to avoid early 2515-2535 token blockers. Skipped no-reference targets remain fixed-set zeros locally. If missing references are recovered, create a new budget version rather than mutating this one.
